p1_findings.finding: The exact runner uses absolute hostname/nvidia-smi, but passes nvidia-smi output through unqualified sed and uses unqualified awk/pgrep/readlink/sha256sum throughout admission. Neither wrapper nor runner sanitizes PATH or exported functions.
p1_findings.impact: A direct exact-runner invocation with the public environment can PATH-spoof filters to forge the literal GPU values sealed in initial/final receipts and can bypass resource/idle gates. The verifier checks receipt values but does not independently observe the host/GPU, so a forged receipt can be admitted.
p1_findings.required_fix: Before any external command, clear exported functions and pin a trusted PATH; use absolute system paths for every admission/identity-critical utility, especially sed/awk/readlink/sha256sum/pgrep. Prefer one absolute nvidia-smi query with shell literal parsing. Reseal runner/wrapper/verifier/contract and request another fresh hammer.

p2_findings.finding: Critical package identity is interpreter SHA plus distribution versions, not wheel RECORD or install-tree content.
p2_findings.recommendation: Seal critical package RECORD/install-tree identities or retain an explicit provenance limitation.

p2_findings.finding: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES and related device-mapping environment are neither cleared nor recorded.
p2_findings.recommendation: Pin/clear device mapping in both entrypoints and seal the effective mapping in receipts.

authorization.next_action: Close M637-P1-01 by removing PATH/function substitution from the admission root, reseal all changed identities, and request a fresh static hammer.
